question: Approve the ideation design for browser sessions scoped by project or workspace, with the unit and the default, and the prototype run?

artifacts.summary: Session mode per project (Shared / This project / Each workspace), hashed scoped partitions, anchored attach gate, opener-session popups, no migration, Electron only. About 950 lines ±30%, 11 acceptance criteria. Needs: unit and default choice, and approval of the prototype run (npm install or a 400 MB Electron-only run).
